result.reason: The clause appropriately confirms Client ownership of Customer Data and removes resale/exploitation rights, but it does not reach either playbook position for deliverables. Saying Client “retains” rights in Support Services work product does not assign Vendor-created work product, and the clause neither addresses Vendor pre-existing IP embedded in deliverables nor grants the required perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence. It also lacks an express no-joint-ownership position. Further, the blanket ownership claim over all Support Services work product has no carve-out for Vendor generic tools or know-how, while the added de-identified service-improvement right is an unnecessary concession not required by the playbook.
